fields.notes:
In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: the dancer Candrahāsa; also one of the yajña-patnīs (v. 192) (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 143, 192). Dates/place from B. V. Tīrtha, “Sri Chaitanya: His Associates”.

Parents: Śrī Kamalākṣa Bhaṭṭa (son of Bhaṭṭa Nārāyaṇa); wife Duḥkhinī Devī. He preached the Holy Name at Nīlācala, brought the Deity of the lotus-eyed Lord to Yaśorā near Cākdaha, and fed the baby Gaurahari on an Ekādaśī from his house. The fifteenth branch of Lord Nityānanda (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.30).

The record «Jagadīśa» #1826 was the same person and was joined to this one (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Mamu Ṭhākura (Jagannātha Cakravartī)
fields.aka: Jagannātha Cakravartī, Mamu Gosvāmī, Jagannātha Dvija Cakravartī
fields.notes:
His original name was Jagannātha Cakravartī, the nephew of Śrī Nīlāmbara Cakravartī, of Magaḍobā in Faridpur. Of Gadādhara's branch (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 12.80); after Gadādhara's disappearance he served Ṭoṭā-Gopīnātha in Purī, and he guided Narottama to the places of Mahāprabhu's pastimes there. In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Kalabhāṣiṇī (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 196, 205).

The record «Jagannātha (Jagannātha Dvija Cakravartī Mamu Ṭhākura)» #547 was the same person and was joined to this one (07-11-2026).
